poses.caption: Rest back and head on the mat, arms crossed over chest and feet flat
Lift shoulder blades and rotate the right shoulder toward the left knee
Return down between repetitions, then curl and rotate the left shoulder toward the right knee

jobs.detail: OBLIQUE FLOOR CRUNCH, THREE equal panels. Same model head image LEFT feet RIGHT lying on mat, knees bent and BOTH feet flat hip width throughout. Arms CROSSED over CHEST, each hand opposite shoulder, per canonical option. LEFT supine neutral back/skull/shoulders fully on mat, face up. MIDDLE curl shoulder blades modestly OFF mat while rotating RIGHT SHOULDER toward LEFT KNEE, opposite shoulder stays low, pelvis stays mat, knees/feet motionless. RIGHT after returning down between repetitions (not separate panel), curl and rotate LEFT SHOULDER toward RIGHT KNEE, opposite twist direction clearly visible, no side-lying. Neck follows torso, no full sit-up. Legs identical across phases, only upper torso/shoulder line rotates. Soft diffuse red tint over intact opaque BLACK ABDOMINAL SHIRT only, no muscle segmentation/fibers/cutaways. All exposed anatomy grayscale detailed fibers. Entire person within each panel, no labels/arrows.
jobs.prompt: Edit this original project three-panel crossed-arm oblique crunch. Preserve model, floor mat, camera, bent knees and planted feet, full opaque shirt and shorts around front sides back seat crotch, fine grayscale muscle fibers on exposed arms/legs. LEFT: lower back of SKULL directly to mat, eyes up, neck neutral, arms crossed on chest, no hovering head. MIDDLE keep current twist. RIGHT must twist torso OPPOSITE to middle: near/foreground shoulder RISES across toward FAR knee, far shoulder LOW near mat. Show near shoulder above far shoulder instead of same low foreground shoulder as middle; both arms still crossed on chest, pelvis flat and legs unchanged. This is a modest shoulder blade curl and rotation, not sit-up. ALL panels erase abdominal muscle segmentation/radial fibers in clothing: continuous opaque BLACK shirt with broad natural fabric folds and one smooth soft diffuse BLURRED red abdominal patch only. No sixpack lines, no cutaways, no text.

Straighten elbows to raise the bar overhead without moving upper arms

jobs.detail: STANDING OLYMPIC STRAIGHT BARBELL OVERHEAD TRICEPS EXTENSION, TWO phases. Three-quarter SIDE view with entire full-length straight Olympic bar, balanced small identical gray plates and collars both ends visible and within each panel. Feet shoulder width planted, torso upright neutral ribs, no bench. BOTH hands shoulder-width OVERHAND closed grip, fingers and thumbs wrap bar securely, identical grip never changes. Upper arms near ears and roughly VERTICAL, shoulders fixed. LEFT LOWERED: elbows flex about90degrees, forearms fold BEHIND HEAD and bar held horizontally BEHIND upper neck/head with safe visible clearance; not in front of face, not resting on neck. RIGHT EXTENDED: straighten elbows to raise bar horizontally overhead directly above shoulder line, upper arms remain near ears, neutral wrists no shrug. Exact same bar length, plates, model/camera/floor each panel. Primary TRICEPS only red anatomical highlight on EXPOSED posterior upper arms; all other muscles grayscale fine fibers. Shirt has NO red and opaque full front sides back. Shorts fully opaque front sides back seat crotch. No text.
